artifacts.summary: Research on a lint-time detector for fixture test-suite dependency-declaration drift: unified extraction algorithm for both the named-array and open-coded declaration shapes, a four-way mandatory-vs-optional source/. classification taxonomy validated against three real historical repair commits, a corrected (wider) population measurement, and a gate-registry.data siting ruling with full precedent-based rationale.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's scripts/lib resolution idioms, a *_CANDIDATES=(...) array + search loop is syntactically IDENTICAL whether the empty-result branch is a hard 'exit 5' (mandatory dependency) or a soft 'inconclusive, passing through' log-and-continue (optional dependency) -- e.g. update-task-status.sh's PHASE_LIB/VOCAB_LIB (mandatory) vs. OVERLAP_LIB/DEPLOY_FRESHNESS_LIB (optional), both inside the same function. Any static lint over this corpus that classifies a CANDIDATES-array pattern as mandatory purely from its shape, without inspecting the empty-branch body for an exit vs. a log-and-continue, will false-positive on the optional instances.

The single-line '[ -f "$VAR" ] && . "$VAR"' idiom in this repo's core scripts (update-task-status.sh's _RR_LIB, task-lock.sh's identical copy) is a documented degrade-safe guard (context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md, 'Redeploy-Remedy Emission Sites', Decision 1(c)): the library's absence is an intentional no-op fallback, never an error. Any lint or audit over this corpus that treats an unconditional-looking source/. reference as always-mandatory must special-case this exact syntactic shape as OPTIONAL.

In agent-system/extensions/core's gate-registry.data, the newest migrated lint gates (27, 29) have NO entry in docs/reference/utility-scripts-inventory.md, while older ones (6, 7, 11) do -- the convention has shifted toward gate-registry.data plus the script's own header being the sole registration record for a gate-wired lint, with the inventory reserved for scripts genuinely outside the normal lifecycle. When sizing a new gate-registered lint's documentation footprint, follow the newest precedent (no inventory entry), not the oldest.
